prompt: In a big-endian file (`MM`), a SHORT tag with count 1 and the value 640 (0x0280) is stored inline in the 4-byte value field. Which four bytes does the field hold?
explain: A SHORT value is left-justified in the value field, so it occupies the first two bytes. In big-endian order the high byte comes first: 02 80, followed by two unused zero bytes.
